meta.publisher: FPS BOSA, from Digitaal Vlaanderen, Paradigm and Service public de Wallonie
meta.attribution: The data are made available by respectively DigitaalVlaanderen (Flemish Region), Paradigm (Brussels-Capital Region), Service public de Wallonie (Walloon Region)
meta.notes: status current only (proposed, rejected, retired dropped), officially unassigned but current addresses kept; box numbers are units; positionSpecification street or municipality marked estimated; Lambert 2008 (EPSG:3812, per each point's srsName) to WGS84 by PROJ; names in the municipality's language: Dutch in Flanders, French in Wallonia except German in the nine German-speaking municipalities, French in bilingual Brussels, then Dutch, French, German in that order where that one is missing; locality is the municipality, postcode is the postal info code, state is the region; Walloon hamlet-type street names kept as the road
meta.draw: lowest sha256('2026:' || register id) among eligible rows

forms.messy: same, without postcode, region and country, abbreviated by OpenCage's lists

meta.truth: the register's point, converted to WGS84 by PROJ where the register uses another CRS
